title: انیمیشن سگ های نگهبان نیرومند قوی
description: Paw Patrol: The Mighty Movie is a 2023 Canadian animated superhero film based on the television series Paw Patrol by Keith Chapman. The sequel to Paw Patrol: The Movie (2021), it was directed by Cal Brunker, who co-wrote the screenplay with Bob Barlen. The film features an ensemble voice cast, including Mckenna Grace, Taraji P. Henson, Marsai Martin, Christian Convery, Kim Kardashian, North West, Saint West, James Marsden, Kristen Bell, and Finn Lee-Epp. Several cast members from both the television series and the previous film also reprised their roles, such as Ron Pardo, Callum Shoniker, Luxton Handspiker, Christian Corrao, and with others joining the cast. In the film, the Paw Patrol pups gain superpowers from crystals inside a meteor and must stop Mayor Humdinger and his new accomplice Victoria Vance, a meteor-obsessed scientist, from wreaking havoc in Adventure City.
